summary: Keep a useful pool selected when enrollment changes the site inventory

guide.reason: The scope menu now defaults to the first pool after enrollment or a removed selection; the guide explains that choice and explicit All pools.

api.reason: The UI still reads the existing sites, pools, hosts and pool-members reports; browser-only scope selection changes no client or Controller/Core contract.

roadmap.reason: This fixes navigation within a completed enrollment workflow; no milestone or built item changes.

state.reason: Only the browser's optional scope preference changes. Pool identity and membership remain on Core and are recovered through existing inventory.

verification.method: Built the web UI, reproduced the All pools failure in a fictional browser fixture before the fix, reran the fixture after the fix, inspected its capture, and ran UI typecheck, documentation and privacy gates.
